script: [serious] Kitno se milne wali ye kahaani, ek insaan ki soch ko hamesha ke liye badal deti hai. [pause] Aaj hum baat karenge Atomic Habits ki — ek aisi kitaab jo sirf padhne ke liye nahi, balki apne aap ko rebuild karne ke liye likhi gayi hai. [instructive] James Clear ne ek seedhi si baat samjhayi — focus, discipline, small consistent action. [authoritative] Ye koi motivation nahi, ye ek discipline hai. [reflective] Aur jo isko samajh gaya, uski zindagi dobara waisi nahi rahegi.
